changes.reason: Koru PR542, PR543 and PR550 merged with an empty reviews endpoint; a required approving review is the minimum independent publication approval. GitHub never counts the pull request author's own review.
The approval must cover the exact head: the last pusher cannot be the approver, so any post-approval push invalidates merge eligibility until re-approved.

RepositoryRole(5) always-bypass let the ordinary author/operator account merge without any review; removing it subjects admins to the same exact-head approval. The Validator App integration bypass is retained because its merges are gated by the independent validator runbook and protected key, outside repository control. A pull_request bypass mode was assessed and rejected: it would still let the role merge without the required review.

preserved: required_status_checks strict_required_status_checks_policy=true (branches must be up to date before merging)
required checks onedev/local-verify and standard packs / conformance carry the OneDev profile's full test and operating-system matrix
RepositoryRole(5) actors may still merge once an exact-head approval exists; the ruleset removes unreviewed merging, not emergency admin ruleset editing (see migration doc residual-risk section)
